subject.title: fix(agents): make model-facing tool schemas llama.cpp GBNF-compatible (#108580)

question: Should this PR become the canonical llama.cpp schema fix after rebasing, or should the overlapping https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108469 carry the work instead?
rationale: Both branches report positive live proof and overlap the same user-visible outage, while both currently require main-conflict resolution; selecting one canonical branch avoids duplicated compatibility policy and fixture churn.

options.title: Rebase this focused branch
options.body: Use this PR as canonical, resolve the merged declaration-key change against current main, and re-review the resulting maxLength removals and generated snapshots.

options.title: Use the overlapping branch
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/108469 canonical only if its rebased merge result is cleaner and retains equivalent full-tool live proof.

recommendation.title: Rebase this focused branch
recommendation.body: Use this PR as canonical, resolve the merged declaration-key change against current main, and re-review the resulting maxLength removals and generated snapshots.
